gold.user: Admin user requesting a list of all cable terminations in the system.
gold.ideal: Returns a list of cable terminations with details such as ID, name, and associated devices.

gold.user: Network engineer creating a new cable entry for a new installation.
gold.ideal: Creates a new cable entry and returns the created cable's details including ID and status.

gold.user: System administrator updating device information for a server.
gold.ideal: Updates the device information and returns the updated device details.

gold.user: Facility manager removing a location that is no longer in use.
gold.ideal: Successfully deletes the specified location and returns a confirmation message.

gold.user: Network technician tracing the path of a specific interface to troubleshoot connectivity issues.
gold.ideal: Returns the trace information for the specified interface, including hop details.

gold.user: Data center operator checking the status of all power feeds.
gold.ideal: Returns a list of all power feeds with their current status and load details.

gold.user: DevOps engineer generating a configuration file for a device.
gold.ideal: Creates a configuration file for the specified device and returns the file details.

gold.user: Product manager updating manufacturer details to reflect a name change.
gold.ideal: Partially updates the manufacturer details and returns the updated information.

gold.user: Warehouse staff adding a new inventory item to the system.
gold.ideal: Creates a new inventory item and returns its details including ID and status.

gold.user: Network administrator reviewing the roles assigned to devices.
gold.ideal: Returns a list of all device roles with descriptions and associated devices.
